rationale: The geometry changes added two sensors behind the front line (y negative) to improve early detection of sharp turns, increased sensor size to 0.016 for noise robustness, and increased wheel track to 0.16 for stability. The race data shows the robot still fails to complete the tracks, terminating off track with 1 line loss event each run, but rms error improved slightly (from ~0.0226 to ~0.0208 average) and progress increased (from ~0.0887 to ~0.095 average). The controller needs tuning to leverage the new sensor layout and larger sensor size. I increased base_speed to 0.14 to exploit improved stability and early sensing, increased kp to 0.18 for stronger proportional correction, slightly increased kd to 0.035 to damp oscillations, and kept ki at 0.02 to avoid integral windup. Sensor weights are adjusted to emphasize the new rear sensors with moderate negative weights to balance the line position signal. Line loss strategy remains 'search_left' as it is effective. Observation request includes all previously requested measurements plus steering_oscillation and control_effort to monitor controller behavior and effort for further tuning.
